serves it as an attachment under the Document's name. A link to this route is enough.

post.description:
Confirms an uploaded file as the Document's newer edition and starts ingesting it. The
current edition keeps serving until the new one is Ready; then the new one replaces it in
place, keeping the Document's ID and Tags. Refused while the Document is being processed.

409.description: This Project is archived. An Owner can restore it. / The file hasn't reached storage yet. Upload it, then confirm. / This upload wasn't found or has expired. Start the upload again. / The file is a duplicate of a Document in the Project (``document_id`` names it). / This Document is still being processed. Try again once it is Ready or Failed.

post.description:
Processes a Document again from its stored file: it goes back to Queued. When the
Document's newer edition is what failed, that edition is retried instead; a Ready Document
is processed again with the Project's current settings (such as OCR), its Chunks serving
until the new ones replace them.

put.description:
Chooses the Project's Embedding Model: the local one, or a provider model with a
Provider Credential that offers it. A Project without Documents switches at once
(``project.embedding_model_changed``). One with Documents gets it as its pending model and
a background re-embed (``project.re_embed_started``); its active model keeps serving until
the job switches over. Choosing again while a re-embed runs cancels it
(``project.re_embed_cancelled``). Follow the re-embed with ``getProjectEmbeddingModel``.

post.description:
Asks the Agent's Live Version a question in the token's Conversation. The answer is
recorded against the Version that was Live when it was generated, and the tokens it used
count against the Agent's daily Token Budget. Messages over the Agent's rate limits, per
Conversation and per IP address, or once the day's budget is spent, get its unavailable
text; the first refusal or reply that finds the budget spent raises the Agent's alert and
emails its Owners, once per day.

parameters.description: `Bearer <conversation token>`
parameters.name: authorization

schema.description: `Bearer <conversation token>`
schema.title: Authorization

200.description: Server-Sent Events. When admission control refuses the message, one `unavailable` event (`reason`: `budget_exhausted` when the Agent's daily Token Budget is spent, or `rate_limited` when the Conversation or the Visitor's IP address is over the Agent's rate limit; and as `message` the Agent's unavailable text); nothing is saved. Otherwise `token` events (`text`), then `citation` events (`label`, `document_name`, `passage`; only when the Live Version shows citations) and one `done` event (`message_id`); or, when the answer leaks the Canary token, a `replace` event (`text`) then `done`; or, when the input Guardrail blocks the message, a `refusal` event (`text`) then `done`, and no model is asked; or, when the model provider fails, one `error` event (`code`, and as `message` the Agent's unavailable text, which names no model or credential).
